content_sections.heading: DHFWO Chikkaballapur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 14 vacancies are available - 1 for District Coordinator AAM, 1 for Physiotherapist (NPCDCS), 1 for Audiologist/Speech Therapist, 1 for Insect Collector, 1 for Health Inspecting Officer (HIO), 3 for X-Ray Technician, 2 for Lab Tech, 1 for Diet Counsellor, 1 for PHCO/ANM (NHM) and 2 for Staff Nurse.

content_sections.heading: DHFWO Chikkaballapur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: District Coordinator AAM: BDS/BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BYNS or M.Sc Life Sciences with MPH/MBA in Health Care/Public Health Management or B.Sc Nursing with MPH/MBA in Health Care/Public Health Management Physiotherapist (NPCDCS): Bachelor's Degree in Physiotherapy (B.P.T) with 2 years experience Audiologist/Speech Therapist: Bachelor's Degree in Speech and Language Pathology from RCI recognized Institute with minimum 2 years experience in Public Health Sector Insect Collector: 2nd PUC/12th Std in Science stream Health Inspecting Officer (HIO): SSLC or PUC with Health Inspector training or 3 years Health Inspector Diploma or 2 years Health Inspector Diploma X-Ray Technician: SSLC and Diploma in X-Ray/Medical Imaging Technology or PUC with Science and Diploma in X-Ray/Medical Imaging Technology Lab Tech: SSLC with 3 years DMLT or PUC with Science with 2 years DMLT and Karnataka Paramedical Board registration Diet Counsellor: B.Sc Nutrition/Dietetics or Diploma in Nutrition and Dietetics/DPHN PHCO/ANM (NHM): SSLC with ANM Training and Karnataka Nursing Council Certificate Staff Nurse: GNM recognized by Nursing Council of India with Karnataka Nursing Council Registration and 2 years hospital experience

content_sections.heading: DHFWO Chikkaballapur Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years for all posts. Age relaxation will be as per government rules. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DHFWO Chikkaballapur Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 10-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DHFWO Chikkaballapur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHFWO Chikkaballapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the DHFWO Chikkaballapur Various Paramedical Posts is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 14 vacancies are available for various paramedical posts in the District Health and Family Welfare Office Chikkaballapur. These positions are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DHFWO Chikkaballapur Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official website or the provided application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this recruitment is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the government norms and regulations.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the selected candidates ranges from Rs. 14,044/- to Rs. 33,000/- per month, depending on the specific post and its pay scale as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary for each post, ranging from SSLC with specific training to Bachelor's degrees in various paramedical fields like BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, BYNS, M.Sc, B.Sc Nursing, B.P.T, and GNM.

faq.answer: The selection process for the DHFWO Chikkaballapur Recruitment 2026 involves an online application followed by document verification. Candidates must ensure all their documents are in order.
